method: Materialize runtime path/point/connection records using decoded AI2 fields and the PC loader/writer layout; run original0x51be90 on every base-matrix cell and original0x51a890 on seeded representative pairs. No native callee replaced. Float return captured with a synthetic FSTP after the original returns.
limits: Tests base routes with selected-route index255 and exclusion mask0. Named subroute groups and dynamic special transforms are not covered.
Runtime records are materialized from bounded decoded fields; this does not itself execute or validate every branch of the AI2 loader.
Live character capability filters, collision steering and dynamic graph updates remain separate.
